question: Will Deutsche Telekom stock be above €26 by the end of October 16, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the Deutsche Telekom AG (ETR:DTE, ISIN DE0005557508) official Xetra closing price on October 16, 2026 — the last auction price recorded by Xetra at the close of its trading session on that date — is strictly above €26.00, provided that closing price is established strictly after 2026-10-14T12:53:24Z and at or before 2026-10-16T22:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the Deutsche Telekom AG (ETR:DTE, ISIN DE0005557508) official Xetra closing price on October 16, 2026 is at or below €26.00, provided that closing price is established strictly after 2026-10-14T12:53:24Z and at or before 2026-10-16T22:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- The reference price is the official Xetra end-of-day closing auction price for ETR:DTE on October 16, 2026, denominated in EUR. If Xetra does not hold a regular trading session on October 16, 2026 (e.g., due to a market holiday), the most recent official Xetra closing price recorded strictly after 2026-10-14T12:53:24Z and at or before 2026-10-16T22:00:00Z is used instead.
